about_the_game:
Cozy Forest is a gentle blend of exploration, light management, and free-form decorating wrapped in cottage-core charm. Leave the city behind, befriend a village of lovable animals, and turn a forgotten woodland into the coziest place on Earth.

Explore & Reconnect

  • Wander lakes, meadows, and ancient ruins brimming with secrets.

  • Unlock new zones as you help each area bloom again.

Build & Craft

  • Gather wood, herbs, and wild fruit to create furniture and tools.

  • Raise cafés, gardens, and workshops that keep the community thriving.

Make Furry Friends

  • Meet bakers, artists, and mischievous mochis—every critter has a story.

  • Fulfil their requests to earn unique gifts and uncover forest lore.

Decorate Your Way

  • Place paths, lanterns, and bridges anywhere with a fully free build system.

  • Swap styles, color palettes, and even seasons to make each corner your own.

Unwind at Your Pace

  • Buildings keep producing while you’re offline—progress without pressure.

  • No ads, no microtransactions, just pure cozy vibes from start to finish.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible con DirectX
  • VR Support: No compatible con VR
  • Additional Notes: Optimizado para dispositivos de bajo rendimiento.

short_description: Restore a sleepy forest with adorable animals. Explore, craft, and decorate a cottage-core haven at your own rhythm—no timers, no hassle. Progress continues while you’re away!
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America
